_comment: Engine DNA defaults. This file is the FALLBACK, not the state: a viewer's
own choices live in localStorage under ARCHIOSK_ENGINE_PREFS and win over
these values. Shipping the defaults as data rather than as literals in JS
means the starting posture of the engine is reviewable in a diff.
Every preference here changes how a drawing is PRESENTED. None of them
changes a source document, a derived orientation, or a classification -
turning the semantic overlay off does not un-classify anything, it stops

preferences.label: Field
preferences.note: Drawings with real colour are never re-tinted by either field.

preferences.label: Semantic overlays
preferences.note: RS-series beams and columns, where a text layer supports grounding. 11 of 49 sheets.

preferences.label: Red annotations / leaders
preferences.note: Requires a text layer. Not derived for any sheet yet, so this stays off and disabled rather than presenting an empty layer as a working one.

preferences.label: Auto-centre on summon
preferences.note: GO centres the evidence it selected. You remain free to pan and zoom afterwards.

preferences.label: Independent sibling stepping
preferences.note: Stepping in Pane 2 never moves the anchored Pane 1.

preferences.label: Strict provenance tooltips
preferences.note: Pointing cards carry the basis and the source file. Turning this off shows the classification without its grounding.
